name: flippars
description: Auditable, abstention-first Bitcoin market signal platform.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @flippars/model-lab && npm run build --workspace @flippars/api && npm run build --workspace @flippars/mobile
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @flippars/contracts && npm run build --workspace @flippars/signal-core
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run repo:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
